description_en: Switches a primary instance to a disaster recovery instance or a disaster recovery instance to a primary instance
description_zh: 该接口用于将RDS MySQL主实例切换成灾备实例，将灾备实例切换成主实例
kebab_example: aliyun rds receive-db-instance --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk500000 --guard-db-instance-id rm-tr2whku00000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReceiveDBInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the primary instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26232.html operation to query the ID of the primary instance
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the disaster recovery instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26232.html operation to query the ID of the disaster recovery instance
parameters.name: guard_db_instance_id

GuardDBInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the disaster recovery instance after the switchover
GuardDBInstanceId.description_zh: 切换完成后的灾备实例ID
